title: Active help allows familiar roles to end

captions.physics: Clarifying hidden debt in useful involvement
captions.emotions: Experiencing a familiar caring role ending

meaning: Your care can support a familiar role ending when active help does not require preserving dependence for reassurance of importance.
text: Helping pass a difficulty need not establish a role forever. In the physical position of Anahata, the Devil describes involvement that can bind through attention in return and quickly confirm the helper’s importance. The Chariot in energy brings a wish to pass a concrete obstacle and make important movement possible. Death in emotions offers the ending of a familiar form of care. A useful action may feel tender while a familiar role’s ending brings sadness. Support preserves freedom when sadness does not require unnecessary dependence to return.

For example, one person has long helped the other prepare every application for small displays. The former arrangement now ends, with only one instance of help sending needed. **A useful contribution grants no right to preserve the entire former role.** One concrete action can finish while the end of familiar joint preparations is acknowledged. Warmth stays in available attention rather than expecting a compulsory return for help or requiring an old service immediately to be replaced by another.

A wish to move can conceal wanting to become indispensable again. Every hesitation seems grounds to restore control. Alternatively, a role’s ending turns former help into a bill to be repaid through closeness. Care distinguishes contribution from entitlement to a person. What was done can be valued and missed while a particular request receives help without restoring an indefinite duty continually to need each other.
